theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_cz_local_agreement
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ W : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U₁ n) (T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U₂ n) (R₁ : IMRep U₁ n) (R₂ : IMRep U₂ n), IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ → W ⊆ U₂ → R₁.Represents T₁ → R₂.Represents T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn W n, currentEval T₁ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = currentEval T₂ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → R₁.measure.restrict W = R₂.measure.restrict W) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) (m + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ball (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 R → currentEval (Ss j) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = C ω) ∧ ∀ β : TestFormOn (Us j) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → (Ss j).boundary β = 0) → ConvergesWeakly Ss C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge Ss C ∧ C.boundary = 0
